summary: JWT auth + protected route tests. Backend pytest: 24/24 passed. Frontend Playwright: all 9 auth flows passed (logged-out redirects, login navigates back, token in localStorage, nav-user/logout visible, refresh persistence via /auth/me, logout clears token, /config gated, invalid-credentials error).

issues: LoginPage does not render the shared AuthNav, so when an authenticated user lands on /login (typed manually) there is no quick way back. Minor UX; not a regression.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py defines get_search_history twice (lines ~487 and ~966) — the second overrides the first. Both currently behave the same (protected, returns history), but the duplicate is confusing and the GET /api/history vs /api/search-history difference should be made explicit.
server.py is ~1150 lines — consider splitting auth, places, history, config, shorten, descriptions into modules.
JWT_SECRET is correctly read from env; good. Consider rotating in production deployments.
AuthContext axios interceptor is registered at module load (side-effect on import). Safe here but technically not idempotent if the module reloads.

Backend allow_origins splits CORS_ORIGINS by comma; current value '*' with allow_credentials=True is a known FastAPI inconsistency (browsers will reject Authorization with wildcard + credentials). Not breaking current bearer-header flow but worth tightening.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use existing user and create TEST_<uuid>@example.com users for register checks (not cleaned up — minor).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is fully working. JWT bearer flow, 7-day TTL. Token key in localStorage: mdc_access_token. ProtectedRoute redirects unauth users to /login with state.from; LoginPage navigates back after success. AuthContext rehydrates via GET /api/auth/me on mount. All protected endpoints (/api/history*, /api/search-history, PUT /api/config/category, POST /api/config/reset) return 401 without token, 200 with valid token. Public endpoints (/api/config GET, /api/categories, /api/regions, /api/places/search, /api/shorten-status, /api/shorten-links, /api/generate-descriptions) remain accessible. Note: server.py has a duplicate function name get_search_history — refactor recommended but functionally correct.
rca of the issue: No issues found. One Playwright assumption was wrong (expected nav-login on LoginPage); LoginPage intentionally does not render AuthNav. Verified nav-login/nav-logout work correctly on SearchPage.
